steps.headline: Round chips, "Not backed up" beside the name, ⋯ first, and buttons that say what they do.
steps.changed: Every tag chip now has the theme's round shape. "Unsaved changes" became "Not backed up" and sits beside the name, next to the status label: it warns about the copy on this computer (changes not committed or not pushed), not about the work's progress. ⋯ moved to the left of the buttons. Open became "View chats"; Review became "Open review deck".
steps.notice: "Needs your look" is about the work (screens wait for your approval); "Not backed up" is about safety (changes that exist only on this computer). Pointing at each says so.

steps.path: Today → Needs you, ⋯ opened on Sync safety
steps.headline: Pause… and Close… now say exactly what they do, right in the menu.
steps.changed: Pause…: marks it paused on its card, with your reason; its branch, copy and pull request stay exactly as they are. Close…: saves unsaved changes to a backup branch, closes its pull request, removes its copy from this computer and marks the card closed; the branch stays on GitHub.
steps.notice: Every main button's hover now names its real effect too, e.g. Merge to master: "Merges its pull request into master, then deletes the branch."

steps.path: Today → Being worked on → View chats
steps.headline: "Join chat" is now "Go to chat": it switches to the conversation that is working on it.
steps.changed: A working chat offers Go to chat (it is open now); a past chat offers Resume chat (reopens it where it left off). The section line reads "A chat worked on these in the last 24 hours."
steps.notice: Idle work's main button is now "Resume latest chat"; Paused work's is "Unpause".
steps.risk: Go to chat assumes the working conversation is open on this computer; one running on another device would need its own wording.

steps.path: Today → Everything else → Helper agents → View chats
steps.headline: View chats opens the list inside the row; every chat button says Resume chat.
steps.changed: The button toggles between View chats and Hide chats. Inside: progress, the three conversations with Resume chat each, and Start another chat on this card.
steps.notice: Nothing opens a separate window or GitHub: View chats only unfolds this row.
